Capacity.description:
X1/X2 installation capacity: slot load, per-node placement eligibility and
per-account provider availability. Owner-only and installation-wide.

IneligibleReason.description:
Why placement would refuse new work on a node. Ceiling reasons are the
placement refusal codes.

InstructionProvenance.description: Where the launch instructions came from; credentials are never projected.

LineageUsage.description: H2 task-lineage ledger totals; spend is a known lower bound unless complete.

rate_card.description: Current configured rate-card revision for this session's provider and model.

NodeSlots.description: A node's slots: `total`/`idle` are null when no backend advertises them.

NodeStorage.description: The latest SBX25 storage report for a node.

NudgeObservation.description: H3 nudge (ladder or owner) and its F3 mailbox delivery.

ProgressObservation.description: Latest semantic progress (turn, tool, question or assistant text), never terminal output.

ProviderAvailability.description:
One configured provider account's availability from unexpired node
credential reports. `observed_at` is the newest report used; it is null
when no unexpired node reports the account's credential profiles.

ReferenceRevision.description: Reference pins retain the owner's numeric revision or exact content digest.

SearchType.description: Owner-specific identity: playbook names are not UUIDs.

last_output_at.description:
Last terminal output the relay recorded for this session. Output is
not progress: repaints and heartbeats also advance it.

observation_binding.description: Independently pinned from the authorized retained offer, never usage input.

SessionLifecycle.description: Historical authenticated worker receipts, independent of process freshness.

SessionOperations.description: Owner-only operations facts for one session (G10 Agents views).

last_output_at.description:
Last terminal output the relay recorded for this session. Output is
not progress: repaints and heartbeats also advance it.

SlotSummary.description:
Sandbox slots across online, unrevoked workers. `occupied` counts every
task-holding attempt; `total` and `idle` are unknown while any online
worker advertises no slot total (host-native workers).

StallQuarantine.description: H3 rung-5 quarantine: scoped to one session and its task lineage, never the worker.

StallState.description: H3 stall-ladder episode for one attempt, with the evidence it last judged.

explanation.description: Evidence the ladder has explained away (for example an open tool or a wait).

observed_through.description: Evidence the ladder has observed up to.

revision.description: Episode compare-and-set revision; zero for a freshly opened episode.

TerminalReplayRef.description:
H7 terminal replay key: `GET /api/v1/terminals/{terminal_id}/output` serves the
snapshot and replay for exactly this terminal identity and epoch.

WaitObservation.description: H4 wait for this attempt; `observed_at` is the newest member check.
